# entrepot_repository (Resource)

A repository: `hosted` (you publish to it), `proxy` (pull-through cache of an upstream) or `group` (an ordered union of repositories of the same format).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pull-through cache of the public npm registry.
resource "entrepot_repository" "npmjs" {
  name           = "npmjs"
  format         = "npm"
  kind           = "proxy"
  blob_store     = "default"
  anonymous_read = true
  proxy = {
    remote_url   = "https://registry.npmjs.org"
    routing_rule = "internal-names" # never fetch @acme/* from the public registry
  }
  scan = {
    scanners           = ["trivy"]
    mode               = "quarantine"
    severity_threshold = "high"
  }
}

# Raw files checked by MetaDefender before anyone can download them. A
# download waits up to a minute for the verdict, and stays blocked while
# MetaDefender is unavailable. hold_seconds and block_on_error require
# Entrepot 1.2.0 or later.
resource "entrepot_repository" "downloads" {
  name       = "downloads"
  format     = "raw"
  kind       = "hosted"
  blob_store = "default"
  scan = {
    scanners            = ["metadefender"]
    mode                = "quarantine"
    block_until_scanned = true
    hold_seconds        = 60
    block_on_error      = true
  }
}

# A Docker Hub proxy on its own hostname: `docker pull hub.entrepot.example.com/library/alpine`,
# and usable as Docker Engine's registry mirror ({"registry-mirrors": ["https://hub.entrepot.example.com"]}).
# Point DNS and TLS for the name at Entrepot. docker.host requires Entrepot 1.3.1 or later.
resource "entrepot_repository" "docker_hub" {
  name           = "docker-hub"
  format         = "docker"
  kind           = "proxy"
  blob_store     = "default"
  anonymous_read = true # Docker Engine doesn't send Entrepot credentials to a mirror
  proxy = {
    remote_url = "https://registry-1.docker.io"
  }
  docker = {
    host = "hub.entrepot.example.com"
  }
}

# Internal packages, published by CI.
resource "entrepot_repository" "npm_internal" {
  name             = "npm-internal"
  format           = "npm"
  kind             = "hosted"
  blob_store       = "default"
  cleanup_policies = ["prune-prereleases"]

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true # replacing a repository deletes its content
  }
}

# One URL for clients: internal packages first, then npmjs.
resource "entrepot_repository" "npm" {
  name       = "npm"
  format     = "npm"
  kind       = "group"
  blob_store = "default"
  group = {
    members       = [entrepot_repository.npm_internal.name, entrepot_repository.npmjs.name]
    prefer_hosted = true # dependency-confusion protection
  }
}

# A signed Apt repository with two distributions.
resource "entrepot_repository" "apt" {
  name       = "apt-internal"
  format     = "apt"
  kind       = "hosted"
  blob_store = "default"
  hosted = {
    apt = {
      distributions = [
        { name = "bookworm", components = ["main"], architectures = ["amd64", "arm64", "all"] },
        { name = "noble", components = ["main"], architectures = ["amd64", "all"] },
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `blob_store` (String) Blob store for the repository's content. Changing it forces a new repository (content is not migrated).
- `format` (String) One of `raw`, `pypi`, `npm`, `docker`, `apt`, `yum`, `helm`. Changing it forces a new repository.
- `kind` (String) `hosted`, `proxy` or `group`. Changing it forces a new repository.
- `name` (String) Repository name (part of client URLs). Changing it forces a new repository.

### Optional

- `anonymous_read` (Boolean) Allow unauthenticated reads.
- `cleanup_policies` (List of String) Names of `entrepot_cleanup_policy`s applied to the repository.
- `description` (String)
- `docker` (Attributes) Docker repositories only. Requires Entrepot 1.3.1 or later. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--docker))
- `group` (Attributes) Required for `kind = "group"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group))
- `hosted` (Attributes) Settings for `kind = "hosted"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted))
- `online` (Boolean) Offline proxies serve only cached content.
- `proxy` (Attributes) Required for `kind = "proxy"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy))
- `scan` (Attributes) Vulnerability scanning policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `url` (String) URL to configure package clients with.

<a id="nestedatt--docker"></a>
### Nested Schema for `docker`

Required:

- `host` (String) Hostname on which the registry API is this repository, e.g. `hub.entrepot.example.com`: images become `host/image` instead of `entrepot-host/repository/image`, and a Docker Hub proxy can be Docker Engine's `registry-mirrors` entry. Point DNS and TLS for it at Entrepot. Unique across repositories, and not the server's own host. The path form keeps working.


<a id="nestedatt--group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group`

Required:

- `members` (List of String) Member repositories, searched in order.

Optional:

- `prefer_hosted` (Boolean) npm/PyPI/Helm: never serve a package name from proxy members when a hosted member has it (dependency-confusion protection). Server default: true.


<a id="nestedatt--hosted"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted`

Optional:

- `allow_redeploy` (Boolean) Allow overwriting existing versions (for Docker: moving tags). Server default: false, true for Docker.
- `apt` (Attributes) Apt distributions to publish. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted--apt))
- `yum` (Attributes) Yum repodata settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted--yum))

<a id="nestedatt--hosted--apt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted.apt`

Optional:

- `distributions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted--apt--distributions))

<a id="nestedatt--hosted--apt--distributions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted.apt.distributions`

Required:

- `name` (String) e.g. `stable`, `bookworm`.

Optional:

- `architectures` (List of String) Architectures, e.g. `amd64`, `arm64`, `all`.
- `components` (List of String) Components (default `main`).
- `label` (String)
- `origin` (String)



<a id="nestedatt--hosted--yum"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted.yum`

Optional:

- `repodata_depth` (Number) Directory depth at which repodata is generated (0 = root).



<a id="nestedatt--proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy`

Required:

- `remote_url` (String) Upstream URL, e.g. `https://registry.npmjs.org`.

Optional:

- `content_ttl_seconds` (Number) Cache time for artifacts (default: never expire).
- `metadata_ttl_seconds` (Number) Cache time for indexes/metadata (server default 3600).
- `negative_cache_ttl_seconds` (Number) Cache time for upstream 404s (server default 300, -1 disables).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Write-only: never returned by the API, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `routing_rule` (String) Name of an `entrepot_routing_rule` restricting what is fetched upstream.
- `username` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--scan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan`

Optional:

- `block_on_error` (Boolean) Quarantine mode: fail closed, blocking downloads of components whose latest scan failed until a retry succeeds. Verdicts become strict: a component stays pending until every selected scanner has scanned its current content. Server default: false. Requires Entrepot 1.2.0 or later.
- `block_until_scanned` (Boolean) Quarantine mode: block downloads of components that have not been scanned yet. Server default: false.
- `distro` (String) Apt/Yum: distribution for vulnerability matching, e.g. `debian-12`, `rocky-9`.
- `hold_seconds` (Number) Quarantine mode with `block_until_scanned`: keep a download of content that is still being scanned open for up to this many seconds, waiting for the verdict, instead of refusing it at once. When the hold runs out the client gets `503` with `Retry-After`. Server default: 0 (no hold). Requires Entrepot 1.2.0 or later.
- `mode` (String) `off`, `warn` (record findings) or `quarantine` (block downloads). Server default: warn.
- `on_proxy_fetch` (Boolean)
- `on_upload` (Boolean)
- `scanners` (List of String) Names of `entrepot_scanner`s to run.
- `severity_threshold` (String) Lowest severity that quarantines. Server default: high.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Repositories are imported by name.
terraform import entrepot_repository.npm_internal npm-internal
```
